tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (9.9:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: ecosystem-white
tokens.usage: Clean canvas, breathable space, open platform. Used as background on `.header`, `.footer`.

tokens.name: network-blue
tokens.usage: Trust, connectivity, professional networking. Used as text on `.nav-link:hover`, `.member-stat-value`, `.btn-secondary`. 3.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: connection-green
tokens.usage: Growth, active engagement, thriving community. Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.badge.active`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: slate-50
tokens.usage: Clean canvas, breathable space, open platform. Used as background on `.header`, `.footer`.

tokens.name: slate-400
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.search-icon`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text, supporting information. Used as text on `.section-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.member-role`. 4.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.nav-link`, `.stat-change`, `.data-table th`. 7.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: slate-700
tokens.usage: Primary text, strong hierarchy. Used as text on `body`, `.data-table td`. 9.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.header`, `.footer`, `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles — as `h1.header-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings — as `h2.section-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles — as `h3.table-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Minor headings, set in uppercase — as `h4` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `td` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels — as `button.btn-tertiary` on the reference page. The reference page leaves this element on the browser default face; set it in the body family.
